name: Konoha Hatoko
source:
A person who thinks and acts on her own, with a large tolerance level.

She only shows her true self to the protagonist, she can be sarcastic, and airs out her complaints to him. She is the protagonist's "sister" and currently lives alone in an apartment, it is very spacious.

She has calculated gestures, behavior, and makeup that she is very particular about.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/akiba/charashokai/hatoko.htm]official site[/url]]
